content: माधुकर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [मधुकर-अण्] Relating to or resembling a bee; as in माधुकरी वृत्तिः. .{@-री@} .²1 Collecting alms by begging from door to door, as a bee collects honey by moving from flower to flower. .²2 Alms obtained from five different places; पञ्चस्विहास्याङ्घ्निकरेष्वभिख्याभिक्षाधुना माधुकरसिदृक्षा <ls>N. 7. 104</ls>.
